name: Sri Gnana Prasunambika Devi Nitya Annadanam (Annapurna Bhavan)
signature_dish: Free annadanam meal (rice, sambar, rasam, curd)
why_it_matters: The Sri Kalahasteeswara Devasthanam's free-meal hall, served at Annapurna Bhavan inside the temple complex. Annadanam runs every single day — even during eclipses when the temple sanctum itself closes; on regular days 5,000-8,000 devotees are fed, crossing 50,000 on Maha Shivaratri and during Karthika Masam. Funded by donor endowments, served sit-down on banana leaf.
insider_tip: Walk-in, no token, no cost — meals at lunch and dinner only, the hall is closed between services. After the rahu-ketu pariharam pujas the queue spikes; arrive at the start of a service batch for a faster seat.
signature_address: Annapurna Bhavan, Sri Kalahasti Devasthanam, Srikalahasti 517644

name: BSVS Aarya Bhavan
why_it_matters: TripAdvisor's #2-ranked restaurant in Srikalahasti, on Car Street a short walk from the temple gopuram — a clean, well-run pure-veg tiffin-and-meals house in a town where most pilgrim dining is annadanam or basic hotels. Has its own site and a steady review record across TripAdvisor and Restaurant Guru.
insider_tip: Opposite Sridhar Lodge on Car Street — the convenient pre-darshan breakfast stop. South Indian tiffin in the morning, unlimited Andhra meals at lunch; quick turnover during peak temple hours.
signature_address: Car Street, opposite Sridhar Lodge, Srikalahasti 517644

name: Kanishka Multicuisine Restaurant
why_it_matters: TripAdvisor's #1-ranked restaurant in Srikalahasti (5.0/5) and the town's main non-veg option — a notable thing in a temple town otherwise wall-to-wall with annadanam and pure-veg tiffin houses. Draws pilgrims breaking the satvik fast after darshan; portions are reviewer-famous for being generous.
insider_tip: Walk about 800m from the temple's east gopuram, opposite the SBI ADB Bank in Bahadur Pet. The chicken biryani is the must-order and tends to run out by 9pm.
signature_address: Tada Kalahasti Road, opposite SBI ADB Bank, Bahadur Pet, Srikalahasti 517644
